name: use-listbox
title: Auro useListbox
description: Presentation-agnostic listbox mechanics — open state, roving activeIndex, element refs, and outside-pointer dismissal — shared by the select and combobox render layers. Consumed by use-machine.ts.

auro.docs: Internal hook consumed by useSelect (and, later, useCombobox). Provides the roving activeIndex, the open flag, the container/trigger/listbox refs, and portal-safe outside-dismiss. Not intended for direct use.
